text:
jamie_support: Heads up — seeing a cluster of orgs (about 18) with $0 or NaN in the token-cost dashboard starting ~2026-03-15 10:00 UTC. Screenshot attached in thread. Anyone else?

maria_eng: I can repro on staging with a smaller dataset. Looks like hourly rollups for some orgs are missing, but raw ledger rows exist.

aj_sre: ops-bot reported a deployment to metering-service at 09:58 UTC, might be related. @kevin_data can you pull the join query we run for the dashboard? :eyes:

kevin_data: Query from dashboard pipeline (simplified):
```
SELECT o.id as org_id, sum(t.cost) as token_cost
FROM orgs o
LEFT JOIN ledger_hourly t ON t.org_id = o.id AND t.hour >= :start
GROUP BY o.id;
```
Looks normal — but in the real pipeline we join through a materialized table that had a recent schema migration which added reserved_capacity columns.

maria_eng: I compared results from the raw ledger vs. the rollup job: some orgs had NULL in the rollup.key_namespace column after the migration. The dashboard query implicitly filters by namespace in a WHERE clause in the materialized view, so rows with NULL were dropped -> yields zero/NaN when summed.

jamie_support: That matches what support sees: orgs that use reserved capacity plans mostly. Is there a short-term workaround for affected customers?

aj_sre: Temporary mitigation: change the dashboard query to coalesce the namespace and treat NULL as 'default' so the rollup includes them. Example patch:
```
SELECT org_id, sum(cost) FROM rollup
WHERE coalesce(key_namespace, 'default') = :namespace
GROUP BY org_id;
```
We can push as a query-level fix to the BI layer today.

kevin_data: For the longer term, we should backfill the materialized table to populate key_namespace and re-run the downsampler. I can schedule a backfill job.

maria_eng: Repro steps I used on staging:
1) deploy migration that adds reserved_capacity column but don't set default
2) run rollup job once -> some rows have key_namespace = NULL
3) run dashboard query that filters on namespace -> those orgs show 0 or NaN

Logs I saw from metering-service around 09:58:
```
2026-03-15T09:58:12Z ERROR metering.rollup - missing key_namespace for org_id=org_83a2
2026-03-15T09:58:12Z WARN  metering.rollup - defaulting to NULL for namespace
```

jamie_support: Customer-facing notes? I told one customer we had an analytics glitch and we're investigating; they'd like ETA.

aj_sre: ETA: quick BI query patch -> 30m to deploy in console (feature flagged). Backfill -> depends on size, estimate 2-4 hours for affected partitions. I'll own console rollout, @kevin_data own backfill.

kevin_data: Running an initial dry-run backfill on a single partition now. If it looks good I'll run the full backfill tonight. Will post progress here.

ops-bot: Deployment notice: metering-service v1.14.0 rolled out at 2026-03-15T09:58:10Z by deploy-bot.

maria_eng: Action items:
- aj_sre: push query coalesce patch to BI (feature flag) and update dashboard mapping.
- kevin_data: run and validate backfill, re-materialize the view.
- maria_eng: add a migration test to ensure new schema defaults are set and rollup handles NULLs.
- jamie_support: update customers with ETA and mitigation steps (dashboard will show correct values once BI patch is live).

jamie_support: Thanks — I'll send an SLA-safe update: "Identified a data join edge case after a recent schema change. Temporary dashboard patch rolling out, full backfill scheduled. We'll follow up when complete."

aj_sre: Quick query patch deployed to staging and feature-flagged on prod. Toggling on now for the affected org list.

kevin_data: Backfill progress: dry-run for org shard 3 completed, corrected ~18k hourly rows. Full backfill queued, expected finish ~2026-03-15T15:30 UTC.

maria_eng: Added unit test for migration to prevent NULL key_namespace in next PR.

jamie_support: Closing loop with customers now. Leaving thread open until backfill done + dashboard verified. :white_check_mark:

kevin_data: Backfill finished at 2026-03-15T15:28 UTC, re-run dashboard materialized view, values look restored in staging and prod samples.

jamie_support: Confirmed with customer — numbers back to normal. I'll file a short post-incident note next week.

aj_sre: Filing incident ticket: INC-2026-0315-token-zero-join. Assigning to kevin_data + maria_eng.

maria_eng: TL;DR root cause: schema migration added new column without default -> rollup produced NULLs -> dashboard filters dropped those rows. Fix: BI coalesce patch (short-term) + backfill + migration test (long-term).
